PrimaryDecision: Changes in matched-cohort ensemble means at adjacent dt values; paired-seed absolute changes are reported as sensitivity diagnostics, not trajectory-identity requirements.
CrossingTrend: Report all adjacent-dt rates. For acceptance, candidate and finer rate must both be <=0.01/model/s; non-monotone changes at rare-event scale remain visible rather than being hidden.
ExactOverlapCriterion: Zero sampled exact overlaps in both candidate and finer cohort.
SelectionRule: Only select a candidate if its adjacent comparison and every finer available comparison pass at all three speeds. Prefer bounded turning if both formulations qualify, for explicit physical turn capacity, not greater cohesion.
Limits: Diagnostic project thresholds, not biological constants, hypothesis tests, formal mathematical convergence, or proof over all speeds and initial conditions.
